0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast and 5th in the East) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Atlanta 4-2 on the road and coming off a loss, while Chicago has dropped seven straight. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Chicago is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 126-123 defeat in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
